originalTitle: South Africa dump site collapse kills 14 suspected illegal miners
title: Brave Helpers Search After a Big Dirt Pile Fell Down in South Africa
content:
Hello, My Little Friends!

Hi everyone! I'm your friendly news reporter for Africa. Today, I have a story to share with you from a beautiful country called South Africa. It's a bit of a sad story, but it also shows us how brave people help each other. Did you know? Africa is a giant continent, full of amazing animals, wonderful cultures, and warm-hearted people! South Africa is a country right at the bottom of Africa.

What Happened in South Africa?

In South Africa, something very serious happened. There was a very, very big pile of dirt, rocks, and sand. Imagine a super-duper giant sandcastle, but made of rough dirt and stones. People call this kind of big pile a "dump site." It's where extra dirt and rocks from digging deep underground are put. These piles can be very, very tall. Sadly, this enormous pile of dirt and rocks suddenly fell down! When something big falls down like that, we call it a "collapse." It happened very fast.

Who Was There?

Some grown-ups were near this big pile of dirt and rocks. These grown-ups are called "miners." Miners are people who dig deep under the ground. They dig to find special, valuable things like shiny gold, sparkly diamonds, or other useful metals. It's very hard work! Did you know? South Africa is famous around the world for its gold and diamond mines! People have been digging for these treasures there for a very long time. However, these miners were what we call "illegal miners." This means they were digging in a place where they were not allowed to be. They did not have permission to be there. It's like when your grown-ups tell you not to play in a dangerous place, like near a busy road or in a building that isn't safe. Going to dangerous places without permission can be very risky.

The Sad News

When the huge pile of dirt and rocks collapsed, it was extremely dangerous for the people nearby. Many of them got stuck underneath the falling earth. With great sadness, we learned that fourteen grown-ups lost their lives. This means they are no longer with us. It is a very, very sad thing to happen. Our hearts go out to their families and friends. When such a terrible event happens, it brings a lot of sorrow to many people in the community. We send our kindest thoughts and our biggest wishes of comfort to everyone who is feeling sad because of this news. It is okay to feel sad when sad things happen.

Our Brave Helpers

When sad and difficult things happen, amazing heroes come to help! In South Africa, police officers, firefighters, and special rescue teams rushed to the dump site. These people are called "authorities" because they are the grown-ups who are in charge of helping, keeping people safe, and making things better when something goes wrong. They are searching very, very carefully through all the broken rocks, dirt, and pieces that fell. We call these broken pieces "rubble." They are working tirelessly to find anyone else who might still be trapped under the rubble. Every second counts, and they are doing their very best. Did you know? Rescue teams sometimes use special dogs with super-noses! These brave dogs can sniff out people who are hidden under rubble. They are incredible heroes too! The helpers are using big machines to move the heavy rocks, and sometimes they even dig with their own hands. Their job is to make sure everyone is found and to help anyone who is hurt.

Why is This Dangerous?

Digging for shiny gold or other special treasures can sound exciting, but it must always be done in a very, very safe way. Mines and dump sites can be very risky places. Big piles of dirt, rocks, and sand can be very unstable. "Unstable" means they can easily wobble, slide, or fall down, just like a tower of blocks that is not built properly. That is why grown-ups and experts have very important rules about where people can dig and work. These rules are not there to be mean, but to keep everyone safe and sound. When people go to dangerous places without permission, they put themselves in great danger. It is always important to listen to warnings and rules about safety. Did you know? The ground under our feet can sometimes move just a tiny bit, or even shake, especially when it's very wet or when things are unstable. This can make big piles fall down!

What Happens Next?

The brave helpers will keep searching with all their might until they are absolutely sure that no one else is left under the rubble. They will not give up easily. The grown-ups who are in charge will also try to find out exactly why this very big pile of dirt and rocks collapsed. They want to understand what went wrong. They will learn from this sad event so they can try their very best to make sure something like this doesn't happen again in the future. This helps keep everyone in South Africa safer. It's important to remember that even from sad stories, we can learn valuable lessons about safety, rules, and helping each other.

A Message of Hope

Even though this is a sad story, my little friends, remember that there are always brave helpers in the world. There are always people working hard to make things better and safer for everyone. Let's send our kindest thoughts, our care, and our love to all the families and friends in South Africa who are sad right now. They need our kindness. And let's all remember to always stay safe, listen to our grown-ups, and avoid dangerous places. Safety is so, so important! Thank you for listening, my little friends. I'll be back with more news from our amazing continent, Africa, soon.
summary: In South Africa, brave helpers are searching for people after a very big pile of dirt and rocks collapsed, sadly taking the lives of fourteen grown-ups who were digging there.
whyMatters: This story is important because it reminds us how brave people help when sad things happen, and it teaches us to always be careful and listen to grown-ups about staying safe in dangerous places.

originalTitle: Ethiopia drone strike in north kills three, Tigray sources say
title: News from Africa: Keeping Schools Safe!
content:
Hello, amazing friends all across Africa and beyond! It's your friendly reporter here, bringing you news from our beautiful continent. I hope you are having a wonderful day, full of learning and playing. Today, we have some important news to share from a place called Ethiopia.

What Happened in Ethiopia?

Ethiopia is a very big country in the eastern part of Africa. It has tall mountains, wide rivers, and many friendly people. It's a land full of history and exciting cultures. But sometimes, sad things happen even in beautiful places. We heard some news from the northern part of Ethiopia. Something happened to a school there. A school is a very special building where children like you go to learn, play, and make friends. It's a place for growing smart and happy! People from the area, who we call 'sources', told us that a kind of flying machine hit the school. Three people sadly lost their lives because of this. It was a very sad day for those people and their families. We send our biggest hugs and hopes to them from afar.

Lucky Break for Students

Here is something very important and actually quite lucky to know: The school was on a holiday break when this happened. This means that children were not inside the school building for their classes that day. It was very lucky that no students were there! Imagine if school was in session; it could have been even sadder. We are so thankful that the children were safe at home with their families, enjoying their holiday time. Schools are meant to be safe places. They are where we learn new things, explore ideas, and grow into amazing people. That’s why this news makes us think about safety for everyone, especially children.

What is a Drone?

You might hear a big word called "drone" in the news. What exactly is a drone? Well, imagine a very clever flying toy! It's like a remote-control airplane, but usually much bigger and more powerful. A drone flies high in the sky without a person sitting inside it. Someone on the ground uses a special remote control, almost like a video game controller, to make it fly wherever they want it to go. Sometimes, drones are used for good things. They can help farmers check their fields to see if plants need water. They can help photographers take amazing pictures from high up in the sky. They can even help deliver medicines to places that are hard to reach by road, which helps many people! But sometimes, drones can be used in ways that cause problems or harm. In this sad news, a drone was involved in hitting the school. We are still trying very hard to understand exactly what happened and why. Did you know? Some very tiny drones are so small they can fit in your hand! But other drones can be as big as a small car, or even bigger!

Why Are Schools So Special?

Schools are one of the most important places in any village, town, or city. They are like busy beehives where knowledge is made and shared every single day! At school, you learn to read exciting stories and write your own. You learn to count and solve puzzles with numbers. You draw colourful pictures, create amazing crafts, and sing joyful songs. You also make new friends and learn how to share, take turns, and be kind to everyone around you. Teachers are wonderful helpers and guides who teach you so much. They help you discover new things about the world and about yourself. They help you grow smarter and become a good person. Because schools are so special and precious, they must always be safe. Every child in Africa and around the world deserves to go to a school that is safe from any kind of harm or danger. Schools are for learning and laughter, not for fear. Did you know? In some parts of Africa, children sometimes walk for a very long time, even many hours, just to get to their school and learn! That shows how much they love learning and how important school is to them.

Who is Talking About This?

When big things happen, different people tell us what they know or what they saw. The news said that "Tigray sources" told people about the school being hit. "Sources" are like people who were there, or who heard about it very closely, or who are part of a group that knows. They are telling their part of the story, sharing the information they have. The government is like the group of grown-ups who help run a country. They make rules, try to keep everyone safe, and build things like roads and hospitals. In Ethiopia, there is a "federal government" which is the main government for the whole country. In this news, the federal government of Ethiopia has not said anything about what happened yet. It means they haven't given their official statement or explanation. It's important to listen carefully to what all sides say so we can try to understand the whole story. Did you know? A government is made up of many people working together, like a big team, to help a country and all its people. It's a very important job!

Why is This News Important for Us?

This news is important because it reminds us how much we all need peace. Peace means everyone can live happily and safely together, without fighting or hurting anyone. It means people can be kind to each other and solve problems with talking, not with anger. When a school is hit, even when no students are there, it makes us think. We think about how precious our schools are and how they should be protected. We think about how every child deserves a peaceful place to learn and play every day. It also reminds us that we should always work for safety. Safety means being protected from danger, feeling secure, and being able to grow up without fear. We want all children in Africa to feel safe, whether they are at home, playing outside with friends, or sitting in their classrooms learning. Did you know? The word 'Africa' comes from an old word that some people think means 'sunny place' or 'land of sunshine'! What a lovely thought!

What Happens Next?

When sad things like this happen, people usually try to find out more. They ask many questions like, "Why did this happen?" and "How can we stop it from happening again?" This is very important. There will be people looking for answers. They will talk to witnesses, gather clues, and try to understand what went wrong. This is called an investigation, like detectives solving a puzzle. We hope that everyone involved will work together to find out the truth. Finding the truth can help us learn from mistakes and make things better for the future, so sad things don't happen again. We also hope that the families who lost loved ones get comfort and support during this very sad time. It's important to be kind and helpful to those who are hurting.

Let's Hope for Peace!

It's always sad to hear news about hurt or sadness. But even when things are difficult, we must always keep hope in our hearts. Hope helps us believe that good things can happen and that problems can be solved. We hope that peace will come to every corner of Ethiopia and all of Africa. We hope that all schools will be safe havens – safe and happy places for learning, fun, and making dreams come true for children everywhere. Let's all remember to be kind to each other, to share our toys and our smiles, and to try to solve problems with words, not with fighting. Together, we can work for a world where everyone is safe and happy. Thank you for listening, my wonderful friends. Always remember, you are amazing, and your safety is so important. Goodbye for now, and see you next time!
summary: A school in northern Ethiopia was hit by a flying machine, sadly killing three people during a holiday when no children were present, and officials are looking for answers.
whyMatters: This is important because schools should always be safe places for children to learn and play, and we need to work for peace so everyone can be safe and happy.

originalTitle: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
title: News Flash: Big Rockets Far Away, What Our Leaders Say!
content:
Hello, Amazing Friends!

Hello, hello, my wonderful friends all across Africa! Your special kid-friendly news reporter is here to tell you about something happening far, far away. We always learn about the world together, don't we? It's important to know what's happening, even if it's a bit serious. But don't worry, I will tell you in super simple words, just for you!

What is Happening Far Away?

Imagine two countries, a bit like two big neighbours. Their names are Ukraine and Russia. They are very far from us, way up in a different part of the world. It's so far, you would need to fly in an aeroplane for many, many hours to get there! Sometimes, neighbours don't get along, and that's what's happening there. President Zelenskyy, who is the leader of Ukraine, shared some news with the world. He said that some big, fast rockets, called missiles, have been used in his country. This is sad news, and we'll learn more about it.

Meet the Countries: Ukraine and Russia

Let's talk about these two countries first. They are both in a continent called Europe, very, very far from our beautiful Africa. **Ukraine** is a country with lots of beautiful fields and cities. President Zelenskyy is like the head teacher of this big country. He wants to keep his people safe and happy. **Russia** is another very big country, even bigger than Ukraine! It shares a border with Ukraine. This means they are right next to each other on the map. These two countries have been having a very difficult time, like a big, long argument, for a while now. It's like when friends argue, but much, much bigger and more serious. When countries argue this much, it's called a conflict or a war.

What Are These Missiles?

Now, let's talk about these special rockets. They are called **missiles**. Imagine a giant toy rocket, but much, much bigger! These big rockets can fly very far, really fast! They are not toys, though. They are used in wars to hit targets, sometimes buildings or even other military things. President Zelenskyy said that the missiles used were special ones called 'ballistic missiles'. **Did you know?** Ballistic missiles fly very high up into the sky, almost to space, and then come zooming back down very fast to hit a target! They are super-fast, much faster than any aeroplane you've ever seen. They fly in a big curve, like throwing a ball really, really high. These missiles, President Zelenskyy said, are coming from a country called **North Korea**. North Korea is another country, very far away, way over in Asia. It is a friend, or 'ally', to Russia.

Sad News in Ukraine

The news is that some of these missiles hit a city in Ukraine called **Zaporizhzhia**. That's a big word, isn't it? Zaporizhzhia is a city, a bit like your town or city here in Africa. It has houses, shops, parks, and schools where children like you learn and play. When the missiles hit, it caused a lot of damage. Imagine rockets hitting your school or your friend's house. That's why it's so upsetting. Sadly, President Zelenskyy said that seven people died because of these strikes. That means seven people were hurt so badly that they could not live anymore. This is very, very sad news. Our hearts go out to everyone in Zaporizhzhia. It reminds us why peace is so important. We don't want anyone to get hurt in fighting.

Why Are Countries Friends or Allies?

You heard that North Korea is an 'ally' of Russia. What does 'ally' mean? An 'ally' is like a very good friend who helps you. When countries are allies, they promise to help each other. This help can be for many things, like trading food or goods, sharing ideas, or sometimes, sadly, helping with things like weapons. So, Russia and North Korea are allies. President Zelenskyy is saying that Russia is getting these big missiles from its friend, North Korea, to use in Ukraine. It's like if your friend gave you something to help you in a big game, but this is a very serious game with real consequences for people's lives. **Did you know?** Many countries try to be friends with each other all the time! They sign treaties, which are like promises, to help each other and keep the world safe.

What Does This News Mean?

This news tells us a few important things. First, that the fighting between Ukraine and Russia is still happening. It's making people very sad and causing big problems for families and children who live there. Second, that other countries, like North Korea, are getting involved by helping one side. This can make the situation even more complicated, like when more children join an argument, it becomes harder to solve. Third, and most importantly, it shows us again how much we need peace in the world. When there is fighting, people get hurt, and homes get broken. Nobody wants that for their families or their neighbours.

Let's Hope for Peace

Here in Africa, we believe in 'Ubuntu', which means 'I am because we are'. It's all about kindness and looking out for each other. When we hear sad news like this, it makes us think about how we can all be better friends to each other, both in our homes and around the world. We hope that all the leaders of these countries can find a way to talk and stop the fighting soon. Talking is always better than fighting, don't you think? We wish for peace for all the children and families in Ukraine. **Did you know?** There's a big group of almost all countries in the world called the United Nations, and they work very hard to keep peace and help people everywhere. They try to get countries to talk instead of fight. Thank you for listening, my wonderful friends! Remember to always be kind, always share, and always hope for a peaceful world. See you next time with more news!
summary: President Zelenskyy of Ukraine says that Russia is using big rockets, called missiles, from its friend country North Korea, to attack cities in Ukraine, causing sadness and hurting people, like in Zaporizhzhia where seven people died.
whyMatters: This news is important because it tells us that fighting is still happening far away, people are getting hurt, and more countries are getting involved, which means we must hope for peace so everyone can be safe and happy.
